# Centrelink online account help - Change your withholding percentage for Child Care Subsidy

Instructions on how to change your withholding percentage for Child Care Subsidy (CCS).

## in this guide

- [Step 1: get started](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/centrelink-online-account-help-change-your-withholding-percentage-for-child-care-subsidy#a1)
- [Step 2: update your withholding percentage](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/centrelink-online-account-help-change-your-withholding-percentage-for-child-care-subsidy#a2)
- [Step 3: sign out](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/centrelink-online-account-help-change-your-withholding-percentage-for-child-care-subsidy#a3)

We keep 5% of your CCS entitlement until the end of the financial year. This helps reduce the chance of you getting an overpayment.

Once you confirm your income for the financial year, we’ll balance your CCS to check you’ve been paid the right amount. Find out more about [CCS balancing outcomes](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/understanding-your-child-care-subsidy-balancing-outcome?context=41186).

You can change your withholding percentage to suit your situation. You can do this online using your Centrelink online account up to twice a year. Find out more about [how to manage your payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-manage-your-child-care-subsidy) when things change.

The screenshots in this guide are from a computer. The page layout will look different if you’re using a mobile device.

## Step 1: get started

[Sign in to myGov](https://my.gov.au/) or the [myGov app](https://my.gov.au/en/about/help/mygov-app), and select **Centrelink**.

Select **MENU** from your homepage.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step1a-220626.png)

Select **My family**, followed by **Child care** and **Withholding percentage**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step1b-220626.png)

## Step 2: update your withholding percentage

Select **Update withholding**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2a-220626.png)

Select **Begin** to start.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2b-220626.png)

Enter the new percentage you’d like us to keep, then select **Next**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2c-220626.png)

Select the **calendar icon** and choose the date you’d like to start the withholdings, then select **Next**. You can also enter the date manually as dd/mm/yyyy.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2d-220626.png)

You can also choose the date to stop the withholdings. In this example, no end date has been selected, so the withholdings will continue.

Select **Next**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2e-220626.png)

From the dropdown menu, select the reason for changing your withholding percentage, then select **Next**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2f-220626.png)

Select **Continue**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2g-220626.png)

To save your update, select **Review and submit**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2h-220626.png)

Select **Begin** to proceed.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2i-220626.png)

The next screen will show a summary of your changed withholding percentage.

Check the details are correct, then select **Next**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2j-220626.png)

Read the declaration. Select **I understand and agree to the above terms**, then **Submit**.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2k-220626.png)

### Get your receipt

We’ll give you a **Receipt ID** to confirm your update. Make a note of this number for your records, then select **Return home** to go back to your homepage.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step2l-220626.png)

## Step 3: sign out

From your homepage, you can complete other transactions or select **Return to myGov** to go back to your myGov account.

![](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-06/coa-change-withholdings-percent-ccs-step3a-220626.png)

For your privacy and security, **sign out** when you’ve finished using your myGov account.

View other [online account and Express Plus mobile app guides](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/help-for-mygov-online-accounts-and-mobile-apps) and video demonstrations about using your online account.
